name: components_g4_accumulator
source:
// Accumulator with no DYNAMIC block: der(in.P) takes the steady branch,
// which recovers in.mdot = out.mdot; the node passes P and h through.
Accumulator AC(a1, a2, C = 1e-6, P0 = 300000)

a1.P    = 300000
a1.h    = 120000
a1.mdot = 0.25
p_out   = a2.P
m_out   = a2.mdot
